findings: The main table has 492 repeated appid rows; the EDA keeps the last row and reports the decision.
Wikidata and SteamSpy are left joins, so unmatched games remain visible rather than being dropped.
Review ratio is defined as positive / (positive + negative) and is not a Steam recommendation probability.
Release dates are messy text; only years parsed into 1990–2026 are used in the trend view.
